name: Hunyuan3D WorldClaw
description: Hunyuan3D WorldClaw is the official release of Tencent's newest 3D generation model, trending this week after its launch. It continues the Hunyuan3D line of high-quality 3D asset generation, aimed at game, film, and XR pipelines. A major lab shipping open weights in the 3D space is always worth watching.
highlights: Official release of Tencent's latest 3D generation model
Continues the Hunyuan3D line for asset pipelines
curatorNote: Tencent keeps shipping serious 3D generation models open. WorldClaw arriving hot on the heels of the previous release shows how fast this frontier is moving.
